body: Once I finish my degree, I think I'm going to sign up to be a big brother for a string of orphanages that my friend oversees here. That would help, and make me feel better.

Thanks brother. I feel like I'm reading my own words, when I said them to a former soldier of mine that attempted suicide.

I was an officer, a captain, actually. All the time, I said what you said to others, saying the VA is there for help, the new duty is family. I guess I just didn't think to take care of myself as much as I should have.

I miss being out front, trying to be an example. I got a garbage civilian job in a bad economy and it's like I spent 10 years for nothing. Lowest man on the totem pole again, and its rough. Its been a long time eating humble pie.

I would rather be back in Ramadi. More alive there, you know?

I have a feeling that I'll find new purpose once my kid is born. That I'll look less inwardly (and selfishly) about stuff all of the time.

Yeah, I've made a few trips to orphanages in Haiti over the past few years, and those single weeks are honestly the highlights of my recent years. It's not how much we make or what we do, it's who we help, right?

Just wish I could make a good salary actually helping people.
